covers: one parent turn spawning and waiting for a child-thread agent
prompt: Use the collaboration tool to spawn exactly one subagent. Ask it to reply with a short greeting, wait for it to finish, then reply with one short sentence.
note: The parent and spawned child share one app-server connection. The child emits thread status, turn lifecycle, item lifecycle, agent-message delta, token-usage, and MCP-startup notifications alongside the parent's events. This capture did not emit thread/started for the child.
